pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular sub-polygonal geometry with smooth, softened edge gradients likely due to image resolution; spatial area of dark regions is heterogeneous, with more elongated patches appearing on the lower neck compared to the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pelage forming a topological graph of interconnected pathways; junction nodes predominantly consist of tri-radiate and quadri-radiate intersections; pathway thickness is consistently narrower than the chord length of adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D silhouette visible along the dorsal mane extending from the upper neck through the shoulder transition.
